name: Magpie, Monstrous
body:
This long-tailed, white-bellied avian resembles an over-sized crow.

Monstrous Magpie
CR 1

XP 400
N Small magical beast
Init +2 Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 size)
hp 15 (2d10+4)
Fort +5; Ref +5; Will +1

Speed 10 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee bite +5 (1d4), claw +5 (1d3)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +5)

At-will—teleport object (up to 30 feet on the same plane only)
1/minute—invisibility (object only)
1/day—shrink item

Str 11, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 4, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +2; CMB +1; CMD13
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +13, Perception +6, Sleight of Hand +11, Stealth +11; Racial Modifiers +4 Sleight of Hand
Languages Common

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary, flock (2-8), or tiding (9-20)
Treasure standard

Larger and smarter than average magpies, monstrous magpies are noted for their rudimentary intelligence and their peculiar magical skills. A monstrous magpies spell-like abilities are all focused on hiding, manipulating, and rearranging objects, complementing the magpie’s mundane knack for thievery. Monstrous magpies are clever enough to recognize and horde valuable objects. They are also cunning enough to confound opponents with invisible obstacles, and to drop teleported objects on their foes.
